Plot a Sankey Diagram following WJP style guidelines

Source: R/sankeyChart.R
wjp_sankey.Rd

wjp_sankey() draws a three-column flow diagram (a sankey) such as the justice pathways of WJP country reports: a first column of nodes (e.g., contacted an adviser or not), a second column of nodes that each come from one first-column node (their parent), and a third column of outcome nodes that each second-column node flows into (its outcome). Every node carries a boxed label with its printed value.

Usage

wjp_sankey(
  data,
  column,
  node,
  target,
  value_labels = NULL,
  parent,
  outcome,
  labels = NULL,
  headers = NULL,
  notes = NULL,
  colors = NULL,
  alpha = c(0.3, 0.45),
  bar_width = 11,
  gap = 9,
  width = 604.8,
  flow_height = 300,
  flow_top = 62,
  flow_bottom = 10,
  side_margin = 92,
  node_color = "#8E9393",
  header_size = 10.8,
  header_fontface = "bold.italic",
  header_colour = "#575796",
  header_lineheight = 1.25,
  header_baseline = 14,
  label_size = 10,
  label_colour = "#1A1A1A",
  value_fontface = "semibold.italic",
  value_colors = "#575796",
  note_size = 8.75,
  note_colour = "#7D7DA8",
  box_fill = "#F2F3F3",
  box_border = "#1A1A1A",
  box_border_width = 0.6,
  box_radius = 2.5,
  box_padding = c(3, 7),
  line_height = 1.22,
  ptheme = WJP_theme()
)

Arguments

data

Data frame with one row per node.

column

String. Column name with the column of each node (1, 2, or 3).

node

String. Column name with the key of each node (unique within its column).

target

String. Column name with the value of each node.

value_labels

String. Column name with the printed value of each node. Default is NULL (no values).

parent

String. Column name with the first-column node of each second-column node.

outcome

String. Column name with the third-column node of each second-column node.

labels

String. Column name with the box label of each node. Default is NULL (the node keys).

headers

Character vector of length 3 with the column titles (use "\n" for line breaks). Default is NULL (no titles).

notes

String. Column name with an optional note printed below the value of a node. Default is NULL.

colors

Named vector of colors, one per third-column node. Default is NULL (the WJP palette).

alpha

Numeric vector of length 2 with the opacity of the flows into the second and the third column. Default is c(0.30, 0.45).

bar_width

Numeric. Width of the node bars, in points. Default is 11.

gap

Numeric. Vertical gap between the nodes of a column, in points. Default is 9.

width

Numeric. Width of the chart, in points. Default is 604.8 (8.4 inches).

flow_height

Numeric. Height of the flow area, in points. Default is 300.

flow_top

Numeric. Space above the flow area for the column titles, in points. Default is 62.

flow_bottom

Numeric. Space below the flow area, in points. Default is 10.

side_margin

Numeric. Distance from the left and right edges of the chart to the outer bars, in points. Default is 92.

node_color

String. Color of the first-column bars. Default is "#8E9393".

header_size

Numeric. Size of the column titles, in points. Default is 10.8.

header_fontface

String. Font face of the column titles. Default is "bold.italic".

header_colour

String. Color of the column titles. Default is the report color "#575796".

header_lineheight

Numeric. Line height of the column titles, as a multiple of their size. Default is 1.25.

header_baseline

Numeric. Baseline of the first title line, in points from the top of the chart. Default is 14.

label_size

Numeric. Size of the box labels and values, in points. Default is 10.

label_colour

String. Color of the box labels. Default is "#1A1A1A".

value_fontface

String. Font face of the values. Default is "semibold.italic" (bold italic when that weight is not available; see wjp_fonts()).

value_colors

Color of the values: one color, or a vector named by node keys for the nodes whose value has another color. Default is "#575796".

note_size

Numeric. Size of the notes, in points. Default is 8.75.

note_colour

String. Color of the notes. Default is "#7D7DA8".

box_fill

String. Fill of the label boxes. Default is "#F2F3F3".

box_border

String. Border color of the label boxes. Default is "#1A1A1A".

box_border_width

Numeric. Border width of the boxes, in points. Default is 0.6.

box_radius

Numeric. Corner radius of the boxes, in points. Default is 2.5.

box_padding

Numeric vector of length 2 with the vertical and horizontal padding of the boxes, in points. Default is c(3, 7).

line_height

Numeric. Line height inside the boxes, as a multiple of label_size. Default is 1.22.

ptheme

ggplot theme to apply. Default is WJP_theme().

Value

A ggplot object.

Details

The function expects one row per node with its column (1, 2, or 3), its key (node), its value (target, e.g. percentages that add up to 100 in each of the first two columns), and its printed value (value_labels). Second-column rows also name their parent (a first-column node) and their outcome (a third-column node). Nodes are stacked from top to bottom in the order of the data within each column.

Heights: first- and second-column nodes are as tall as their target; third-column nodes are as tall as the sum of the second-column nodes that flow into them (their own target is not used for the geometry, so their printed value can follow another definition). The tallest column fills flow_height points including the gaps between its nodes.

Colors: flows, second-column bars, and third-column bars take the color of their outcome (colors, named by the third-column node keys); first-column bars use node_color. Flows from the first to the second column use alpha[1] and flows into the third column alpha[2].

Labels: labels gives the text of each box (use "\n" for line breaks); the printed value goes below it and the optional notes below the value. Column titles are given by headers. The chart is drawn on a canvas of width by flow_top + flow_height + flow_bottom points, so wjp_save() writes it at that exact size.

Examples

# Always load the WJP fonts
wjp_fonts()

# Pathways to accessing an adviser (fictional data)
pathways <- data.frame(
  column  = c(1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3),
  node    = c("contacted", "not_contacted", "appropriate", "non_appropriate",
              "needed_no", "no_need", "access", "no_access", "excluded"),
  value   = c(30, 70, 22, 8, 40, 30, 31, 69, 30),
  parent  = c(NA, NA, "contacted", "contacted", "not_contacted", "not_contacted",
              NA, NA, NA),
  outcome = c(NA, NA, "access", "no_access", "no_access", "excluded", NA, NA, NA),
  label   = c("Contacted an adviser:", "Did not contact an adviser:",
              "Appropriate adviser:", "Non-appropriate adviser:",
              "Needed but did not have\naccess to an adviser:",
              "Did not need an adviser:", "Had access:", "Had no access:",
              "Did not need an adviser:"),
  note    = c(rep(NA, 8), "of all respondents")
)
pathways$text <- paste0(pathways$value, "%")

wjp_sankey(
  pathways,
  column       = "column",
  node         = "node",
  target       = "value",
  value_labels = "text",
  parent       = "parent",
  outcome      = "outcome",
  labels       = "label",
  notes        = "note",
  headers      = c("Contacted\nan adviser", "Type of adviser or\nreason for no contact",
                   "Access among those\nwho needed assistance"),
  colors       = c(access = "#575796", no_access = "#A8A8C8", excluded = "#C4C8C8"),
  value_colors = c(excluded = "#7D7DA8")
)
